cas9_guide_dna_3d_complex.reason: No synthetic Cas9+guide+DNA structure is generated. PDB pointers (4UN3, 4OO8) are catalogued for a future mapping workflow. Coordinates are not loaded.
cas9_guide_dna_3d_complex.requires: deposited Cas-guide-DNA structure and validated mapping

cas_offinder.reason: Found allowlisted executable cas-offinder.exe. Device C (CPU) is preferred when a CPU OpenCL ICD exists; device G is used if only GPU OpenCL is available. This Windows build of Cas-OFFinder still needs a working OpenCL ICD; missing OpenCL is ERROR, not simulated hits. GPU is not required. Cas-OFFinder 3 is not used (not production-ready per upstream).
cas_offinder.requires: allowlisted cas-offinder executable (env HELIXSCOPE_CAS_OFFINDER or PATH) and a working OpenCL ICD. Not a Python reimplementation.

distributed_workers.reason: Local subprocess workers exist for Cas-OFFinder genome jobs. They are not cloud workers, not multi-tenant, and not a public job queue. Authentication and per-user quotas remain UNAVAILABLE.
distributed_workers.requires: authentication, quotas and isolated public workers

genome_wide_off_targets.reason: Genome-wide means a checksum-verified READY public assembly (GRCh38.p14, T2T-CHM13v2.0, or GRCm39) was searched to completion by Cas-OFFinder. Opening CRISPR does not download genomes. A provided FASTA or TEST REFERENCE is not genome-wide. Partial, timed-out, cancelled, or capped jobs do not produce a global specificity score.
genome_wide_off_targets.requires: Cas-OFFinder binary, READY assembly with NCBI MD5 verification, and COMPLETED_FULL_REFERENCE. Auth, quotas and public workers remain UNAVAILABLE.

hsu_2013_single_hit.reason: Per-site Hsu 2013 score for a verified 20 nt spacer pair (CRISPOR calcHitScore / crispr.mit.edu). Scale 0-100. Not the genome-wide MIT Specificity Score. No bulge term.
hsu_2013_single_hit.requires: 20 nt spacer and a verified site with computed mismatches

indel_frameshift_profile.reason: Indel profiles need trained models such as inDelphi or ForeCasT.

on_target_azimuth.reason: Azimuth 2 is Rule Set 2 (Doench et al. 2016), not a second on-target model. The Microsoft Research repository is archived (2024) and is not a supported runtime here.
on_target_azimuth.requires: Official Azimuth runtime and model files compatible with this Python, loaded without untrusted pickle, for SpCas9 30-nt context only.

on_target_deephf.paper: Wang D et al. Nature Communications 10:5804 (2019). Optimized CRISPR guide RNA design for two high-fidelity Cas9 variants by deep learning.
on_target_deephf.reason: DeepHF is a trained recurrent network (Wang et al. 2019). Weights and a deep-learning runtime are not vendored. A house network is not DeepHF.
on_target_deephf.requires: Official DeepHF weights plus a pinned inference environment.

on_target_doench_ruleset2.paper: Doench JG et al. Nature Biotechnology 34:184-191 (2016). Azimuth 2 is the Rule Set 2 on-target model (Microsoft Research, archived 2024).
on_target_doench_ruleset2.reason: Azimuth 2 (Rule Set 2) is an archived Microsoft Research gradient-boosting model whose official pickles target Python 2 / old scikit-learn. HelixScope does not load untrusted pickle weights and does not reimplement the trees. The positional heuristic is not used as a silent substitute for Rule Set 2.
on_target_doench_ruleset2.requires: Official Azimuth runtime and model files compatible with this Python, loaded without untrusted pickle, for SpCas9 30-nt context only.

provided_reference_offtarget_search.reason: PAM-indexed scan of a user FASTA, workspace DNA, or NCBI nucleotide record already in this session, within size limits. Not genome-wide. No automatic assembly download.
provided_reference_offtarget_search.requires: validated reference FASTA in this session

specificity_cfd.reason: Per-site CFD (Doench et al. 2016) with embedded published mismatch and PAM matrices (CRISPOR calcCfdScore / GuideMaker dump). Scale 0-1. Not Rule Set 2. Not a genome-wide score.
specificity_cfd.requires: verified 23-mer spacer+PAM pair (20 nt spacer + 3 nt PAM)

specificity_cfd_guide_aggregate.reason: Guide-level CFD specificity (GuideScan / CRISPOR May 2019) 100/(100+sum) on CFD hits of a COMPLETED search. Scope-limited. NOT_RUN/TIMEOUT/RESOURCE_LIMIT never become 0. Not genome-wide unless that search processed a complete declared assembly.
specificity_cfd_guide_aggregate.requires: completed off-target search with verified CFD per hit

specificity_mit.reason: The genome-wide MIT Specificity Score Sguide aggregates Hsu hit scores over a complete public assembly. This app does not download or process hg38/mm39. Summing hits on a plasmid or locus is a scope-limited aggregate (see specificity_mit_aggregate_over_search), not MIT genome-wide.
specificity_mit.requires: complete declared assembly search plus Hsu aggregate

specificity_mit_aggregate_over_search.reason: CRISPOR calcMitGuideScore = 100/(100+sum of Hsu 2013 single-hit scores) over a COMPLETED search, excluding the intended on-target, including additional exact copies. Alt-PAM Hsu is multiplied by 0.2 as in CRISPOR. Not genome-wide unless the search was.
specificity_mit_aggregate_over_search.requires: completed off-target search with Hsu single-hit scores

scope: TEST REFERENCE / pasted sequence. Not genome-wide. Not GRCh38.
